prompts.prompt: Create a new photorealistic architectural visualization for an interactive educational campus map. The attached image is a STYLE AND CAMERA reference only: match its realistic high-angle aerial cutaway campus photography, desert dawn sunlight, sage shrubs, sandstone rocks, warm neutral concrete buildings and visible interiors. New subject: an unoccupied exoplanet transit photometry research observatory campus on Earth, EXACTLY SIX distinct scientific buildings around a central garden. Wide 3:2 image, target 1536x1024. Three buildings across the top (centres approx x260 y260, x760 y260, x1260 y260), three across bottom (x1260 y720, x760 y720, x260 y720), with curved walkways connecting a clockwise research journey. Top left: optical telescope observatory with a partly open dome and observation desks; top middle: glass data preparation lab with computers and archive racks; top right: scientific computing room with wall charts and a luminous light curve display; bottom right: optical signal inspection lab with small workbenches and compare screens; bottom middle: independent verification control room with sealed storage cabinets and separate screens; bottom left: research archive and presentation room with notebooks and display boards. Open architecture with uncluttered interiors legible from above. Screens show tiny abstract scientific plots, not readable words. The central garden stays quiet for later UI annotations. NO PEOPLE anywhere, no astronauts, no rovers, no robots, no Mars vehicles, no labels, no numbers, no logos, no diagram graphics, no arrows. The result must feel like a real continuous campus photographed with a drone, not a flat diagram or sci-fi painting.

Edit this fictional AI-generated Chinese scientist scene for a coherent sibling webpage about detecting exoplanet transits. Preserve the SAME adult woman, facial identity, dark practical jacket, headset, sitting position, warm approachable expression, hand gesture, research control-room realism, warm desk lamps and blue dusk lighting. The same fictional character Lin Lan accompanies both missions. Change the large upper-right screen from a Mars landscape to a clear scientific visualization: a luminous star partially crossed by a small dark planet, beside a simple cyan brightness-versus-time curve with a few shallow downward transits; no legible numbers or text. Change other Mars globes and rover displays to stellar observation and telescope-data displays. Through the window retain an Earth observatory landscape and antenna. Wide cinematic 16:9, target 1920x1080. Frame the woman on the RIGHT half, with face near 65 percent from left, and gesture toward the right display; the LEFT 40 percent should be uncluttered dark control-room negative space suitable for white webpage text. Real photography style, no title, no labels, no watermark, no new people. This is the welcoming hero, not the unoccupied map background.

verification: Visually inspected generated outputs and in-page screenshots. The six-building campus is unoccupied. Assets optimized to WebP with sharp; original images retained.
